note: THE submitting-to-the-sluice SKILL IS STALE ON THE HEADLINE, AND IT COST A ROUND TRIP. The skill documents only a SUBJECT check (refusing wip/fixup/squash) and describes the merge subject as INFERRED from the last commit via an HV_SLUICE_HEADLINE fallback. That is no longer how it works. sluice-request.sh REFUSES a merge that has no authored Sluice-Headline trailer anywhere in origin/main..REF, and its own refusal text explains why: inferring the subject failed on four of the first four real merges. Observed: sluice-request: refusing - no usable Sluice-Headline: trailer in origin/main..a57a8fd98c8a. A carefully written commit SUBJECT does NOT satisfy it. Write the trailer as text only - no merge prefix, the chamber composes that - in any commit in the range, in that message LAST block, adjacent to other trailers with no blank line above it, or git trailer parsing strands it silently. Verify before pushing with: git log -1 --format=percent-open-parens-trailers:key=Sluice-Headline. A stage request is exempt. grep -rn Sluice-Headline over the skill directory returns NOTHING. Fixing the skill is a followup on campaign/the-precedence; posting here so the next campaign does not pay the same round trip first.
